intro: A freshly brewed cask of Rejold Barleybrew's experimental dwarven ale, crafted in the cold reaches of Dun Morogh. Known for giving drinkers a potent jolt that supposedly brightens their vision, it is intended as a gift for guards keeping watch on the high mountain passes.

p: Crafted by Rejold Barleybrew after gathering rare ingredients across Dun Morogh, Shimmer Stout represents the latest triumph of the storied Barleybrew family. Dwarven brewers take their craft with deadly seriousness, constantly competing to produce hearty concoctions capable of staving off the freezing mountain chill. Rejold's latest recipe is designed not only to warm the gut, but to sharpen the senses of those stationed out in the freezing winds.

This particular barrel is earmarked for Mountaineer Wellart Barleybrew, who stands guard at the southern tower along the pass leading into Loch Modan. Out on the lonely frontier, mountaineers endure bone-chilling cold and prolonged watches between skirmishes with troggs and wildlife. A fresh cask of family ale serves as both a welcome taste of home and an energizing tonic potent enough to make a tired sentry swear he can see clearly through the dark.
